system.lightMode.note: Wuxuu adeegsadaa muuqaal Windows oo iftiin leh; waxaa lagu talinayaa e-paper.
system.lightMode.unavailable: Waxay u baahan tahay Windows 10 May 2019 Update ama ka cusub.
saturation.unavailable: Waxay u baahan tahay Windows 11 24H2 ama ka cusub iyo shaashad taageerta ACM.
saturation.unsupported.upgrade: Hagaajinta dheregga midabka ee E-Ink Assistant laguma taageero shaashaddan. U cusboonaysiinta Windows 11 24H2 ama ka cusub ayaa taageero keeni karta; haddii kale gacanta kaga hagaaji guddiga xakamaynta GPU-ga.
saturation.unsupported.driver: GPU-ga/darawalka hadda ma taageero in E-Ink Assistant uu shaashaddan ka hagaajiyo dheregga midabka. Isku day inaad cusboonaysiiso darawalka garaafyada, ama gacanta kaga hagaaji guddiga xakamaynta GPU-ga.
saturation.manual: Kontaroollada Dheregga midabka iyo RGB way damsan yihiin. Gacanta ayaad sidoo kale uga hagaajin kartaa guddiga xakamaynta GPU-ga.
saturation.unsupported.clone: Windows kuma dabaqi karo Dheregga midabka ama RGB qaabka Nuqulka. U beddel qaabka Ballaarinta si aad u isticmaasho kontaroolladan.
display.cloneWarning: Qaabka Nuqulka ayaa shaqaynaya. Hagaajinnada kale ee shaashaddu waxay sidoo kale saameeyaan: %1.
saturation.experimental.enable: Hawlgeli kontaroollada Dheregga midabka iyo RGB (tijaabo ah)
saturation.experimental.preparing: Tijaabadu waxay bilaabmi doontaa %1 ilbidhiqsi gudahood. Haddii shaashaddu si khaldan u muuqato, si toos ah ayay sidii hore ugu noqon doontaa.
saturation.experimental.confirm: Hubi shaashadda. Haddii aadan xaqiijin, waxay si toos ah sidii hore ugu noqon doontaa %1 ilbidhiqsi gudahood.
saturation.experimental.dialog.preparing: Isbeddel yar oo dheregga midabka ah ayaa la dabaqi doonaa. Eeg madoobaansho aan caadi ahayn, midab leexday ama muuqaal lumay.
saturation.experimental.dialog.confirm.b: Xaqiiji oo keliya haddii aysan jirin madoobaansho aan caadi ahayn, midab leexday ama muuqaal lumay. Haddii kale dib u celi; si toos ah ayay sidoo kale u soo noqon doontaa.
saturation.acm: Wuxuu adeegsadaa maaraynta midabka tooska ah ee Windows. Sidii hore ayuu ku noqdaa marka abka laga baxo.
shaking.unavailable: GPU-gan Windows ugama furna kontarool dithering oo ammaan ah, dadweynuhu heli karo, shaashad kastana u gaar ah.
night.title: Iftiinka habeenkii
night.note: Windows wuxuu Iftiinka habeenkii ku maamulaa nidaamka oo dhan halkii uu shaashad kasta gooni uga maamuli lahaa.
night.fallback.recommendation: Waxaan ku talinaynaa in Iftiinka habeenkii laga damiyo shaashadaha e-paper.
night.disable.title: Dami Iftiinka habeenkii
night.disable.note: Iftiinka habeenkii wuxuu ku daraa midab diirran; u dami e-paper.
night.disable.warning: Shaashadaha e-paper, waxaan ku talinaynaa in Iftiinka habeenkii la damiyo.
help.windows: Dheregga midabka iyo RGB waxay Windows 11 24H2 ama ka cusub ku adeegsadaan maaraynta midabka tooska ah, ama habka borofaylka MHC2 ee Windows 10 dhismayaasha 19041–19045. Kontrastiga qoraalka, Hagaajinta fiidyowga iyo Sare waxay adeegsadaan jadwal gamma oo shaashad kasta u gaar ah. Dhammaan hagaajinnada shaashadda dib ayaa looga noqdaa marka abka laga baxo, mar kalena waa la dabaqaa marka la bilaabo.
welcome.windows.tray: Fur liiska astaamaha qarsoon ee midigta barta hawsha, hel astaantan bogagga buugga ah, ka dibna u jiid qaybta muuqata.
welcome.windows.tray.title: Ku dheji astaanta saxanka nidaamka
